title: The named native scalar tensor paths are equal
statement: For finite R, p:X→Y and P,Q, the three projections of the explicitly constructed left tuple compose to the explicitly named right chain path.

proof.text: Apply the proved commutativity of the native cochain diagram. Reduce its data constructor to its stored tuple projections and right native path, retaining the definitions of these paths. This proves their equality before degree evaluation.

lean.statement:
theorem finiteScalarTensorNative_paths_equal
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [Finite R] {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (p : X ⟶ Y)
    (P Q : CochainComplex
      (Sheaf (ProEt.topology Y) (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} R))) ℤ) :
    (finiteScalarTensorNativeLeftPaths R p P Q).1 ≫
      (finiteScalarTensorNativeLeftPaths R p P Q).2.1 ≫
      (finiteScalarTensorNativeLeftPaths R p P Q).2.2 =
    finiteScalarTensorNativeRightPath R p P Q
